title: Business Formation
scope: Covers Census Business Formation Statistics: seasonally adjusted business applications and projected formations within four quarters, for the United States and each state. Also reports BLS Business Employment Dynamics private-sector establishment birth and death counts and rates for the United States, Massachusetts, and Florida.
exclusions: Does not cover industry clusters or advice about starting a firm. Establishment births and deaths are the BLS BED private-sector series, not Census BDS firm births.
heritage: Formerly Business Births and Deaths and Business Dynamics
vintage_note: Rebuilt Aug 15, 2026 from the Census BFS monthly CSV. Headline series is seasonally adjusted BA_BA, TOTAL NAICS. U.S. Jul 2026 equals 578,926, matching Census press release CB26-130 (August 12, 2026). Later views compiled Aug 15, 2026 are stored under derived.secondary. SRC-613-02.name: BLS Business Employment Dynamics, private-sector establishment births and deaths
SRC-613-02.supports: Covers Census Business Formation Statistics: seasonally adjusted business applications and projected formations within four quarters, for the United States and each state. Also reports BLS Business Employment Dynamics private-sector establishment birth and death counts and rates for the United States and Massachusetts.

q: New business applications from Census BFS, and private-sector establishment births and deaths from BLS BED.
lead: Seasonally adjusted business applications were 578,926 in Jul 2026, +23.4% from a year earlier (SRC-613-01). Massachusetts filed 7,497, rank 25 of 51 (derived, SRC-613-01). BLS Business Employment Dynamics put the Massachusetts private-sector establishment birth rate at 3.9% in 2025 Q4 (8,540 establishments, SRC-613-02). Deaths are published through 2025 Q1, when the death rate was 2.6% (5,722 establishments, SRC-613-02). In the last overlapping quarter, 2025 Q1, the birth rate was 2.9% and the death rate was 2.6% (SRC-613-02). Florida's establishment birth rate was 4.0% in 2025 Q4 (28,035 establishments, SRC-613-02).

bed_births_deaths.label: Private-sector establishment birth and death rates
bed_births_deaths.note: BLS Business Employment Dynamics, total private, seasonally adjusted. Births are a subset of openings; deaths are a subset of closings and lag three quarters. Rates are the component as a percent of the average of current and prior-quarter establishment counts. U.S. counts are thousands of establishments, matching the BLS news release. Florida uses the same statewide total-private series as Massachusetts.
